diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~43% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.107), which favours a robust combination.

test weighted combination with inverse_error on the full pool to leverage strong models and reduce impact of weaker ones, given ranking instability.
test a weighted scheme with softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over inverse_error while using full pool.
Test trimmed_mean on the full pool to see if trimming outliers improves over mean, given strong trend and seasonality.
The series has strong trend/seasonality but unstable ranking; a robust median over a small, correlated‐group pool (pool1) may reduce variance.
Try a dba combination on the full pool to see if the robust DBA approach improves over mean in this mixed‑trend, mixed‑seasonality series.
The series has high trend/seasonality and unstable rankings; a robust weighted scheme using a pooled meta‑model (w1) might capture complementary strengths better than inverse or softmax weights.
Test a weighted inverse_error combination on the smaller, diversified pool1 to see if reducing model count improves robustness given the unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality.
test a weighted combination on a slightly larger pool (pool2) using inverse_error weights to see if adding ONLY_CWT_catboost improves over the full pool w1.
test a weighted combination on the small pool1 using softmax_neg_error weights to see if a softer weighting improves over the hard inverse_error which performed poorly on pool1.
The series has strong trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable; a robust median may damp extreme errors and handle correlated groups.
test a simple mean on the smaller, more stable pool1 to see if reducing model count improves robustness in this mixed regime.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9965. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.107); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.544.
